record.question: Who was the chief guest of the Official ceremony in the Republic Day in 2018?
record.explanation: Answer D: Heads of ASEAN States. The Ministry’s January–March 2018 India Perspectives record identifies ten ASEAN leaders as the Republic Day chief guests. The intended choice is Heads of ASEAN States. Historical/source note: These were heads of state/government, not ten presidents or only heads of state in the narrow constitutional sense. Reference: https://www.mea.gov.in/Images/attach/jan_march_2018.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
